report_markdown:
**Outage watch** 2026-11-09 to 2026-11-16
Okta US Cell 7 experienced 47 minutes of sign-in failures; Stripe reported no incidents.

- **Okta Workforce Identity (US Cell 7)**: About 60% of sign-in attempts failed with HTTP 503. November 12, 15:31–16:18 UTC per status page (47 minutes), resolved. Root cause: not published yet. _For your on-call:_ Check authentication error logs for affected users during this interval and review emergency access procedures. [Incident](https://status.okta.com/incidents/oc-2026-1112); [supplied history](https://status.okta.com/history).

_Checked using supplied snapshots: [Okta](https://status.okta.com/history), [Stripe](https://status.stripe.com). Live sites unavailable; no independent postmortem search._
